rrnB_T1T2.description: Strong dual transcription terminator from E. coli rrnB operon. Used in pET vectors.

T7_Te.description: T7 phage Te terminator. Used downstream of T7-driven genes.

NOS.description: Nopaline synthase terminator from A. tumefaciens Ti plasmid. Standard plant terminator; ~260 bp.
NOS.notes: Most common plant terminator; used in pBI121, pCAMBIA vectors

OCS.description: Octopine synthase terminator from A. tumefaciens. Slightly stronger than NOS.
